name: devops
description: Infrastructure in one plugin: CI/CD ordering, container/image hygiene, Kubernetes limits and probes, deploy strategy with rollback, and secrets handling (devops-practices); and Dockerfile and compose discipline (docker-best-practices). One /devops:review loads the Docker skill when a Dockerfile or compose file is in scope, backed by a PreToolUse guard on workflow files and a devops-engineer worker + devops-reviewer pair. Owns infra-layer observability wiring; defers in-code instrumentation to resilience.

cc_workflow_guard.title: Workflow guard (CC_WORKFLOW_GUARD)
cc_workflow_guard.description: Refuse a GitHub workflow write that hands secrets or a write token to untrusted code: on or off. The environment variable CC_WORKFLOW_GUARD overrides this.
